🎭✨ Complete GitHub Pages Deployment Optimization and CI Pipeline Fixes

This PR completes the final optimization and validation steps required for
production-ready GitHub Pages deployment of the Cosmic Consciousness Portal
system, while also fixing critical CI pipeline issues.

🚀 Key Optimizations Implemented:

### QR Code System Fixed for Production
- Updated mobile portal URL from localhost to GitHub Pages URL
- Improved file path handling with os.path.join for cross-platform compatibility
- Mobile portal now accessible at: https://poisontr33s.github.io/PsychoNoir-Kontrapunkt/mobile.html

### CI Pipeline Fixes
- Fixed GitHub Actions retention-days to hardcoded value of 14
- Added qrcode[pil]==8.2 to automation_requirements.txt
- Created functional Jest test suite in frontend/scripts/script.test.js
- Streamlined backend dependencies to essential: flask, flask-cors, pytest, pytest-cov

### Final Deployment Documentation
- Added comprehensive FINAL_DEPLOYMENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md
- Step-by-step GitHub Pages activation guide
- Troubleshooting instructions and success confirmation criteria

🌌 System Ready for Production Deployment!
